segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ עוּבָּרָה שֶׁהֵרִיחָה — מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתָהּ עַד שֶׁתָּשִׁיב נַפְשָׁהּ. חוֹלֶה — מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ עַל פִּי בְּקִיאִין, וְאִם אֵין שָׁם בְּקִיאִין — מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ עַל פִּי עַצְמוֹ עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר דַּי.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a pregnant woman who smelled» food and was overcome by a craving to eat it, «one feeds her until she recovers,» as failure to do so could lead to a life-threatening situation. If a person is «ill» and requires food due to potential danger, «one feeds him according to» the advice of medical «experts» who determine that he indeed requires food. «And if there are no experts there, one feeds him according to his own» instructions, «until he says» that he has eaten «enough» and needs no more.

moves.summary: pregnant woman and sick person are fed

positions.claim: feed a craving pregnant woman until she recovers; feed the sick by experts or by his own word
